tweetText: Signal's Meredith Whittaker warns that AI chatbots are not friends or conscious beings. This matters because it highlights the need for users to understand the limitations and nature of AI interactions. via TechCrunch AI

A new AI tool called "In the Weights" lets users check their fitness scores and progress. This matters because it combines AI with personal health tracking, making fitness more accessible and engaging. via TechCrunch AI

Nobel laureate John Jumper is leaving DeepMind to join rival Anthropic, following a trend of high-profile exits from Google. This shift highlights the competitive landscape in AI development as top talent moves between leading companies. via TechCrunch AI
Siri's latest AI upgrade makes it more conversational and genuinely helpful. This could change how we interact with technology in our daily lives. via WIRED AI

The Atlantic has launched a searchable database of music datasets used to train AI, featuring millions of tracks. This transparency helps understand AI training practices and the music industry’s role in it. via The Verge AI
